Messages.Author: de...@hell.is
Messages.Body:
Leonardo, Mortician
Ally
Giovanni
1 pool
Unique mortal with 2 life. 1 strength, 0 bleed.
Leonardo may move 1 blood from the blood bank to any ready vampire as a
+1 stealth action.

Procurer
Ally
2 blood
Ghoul with 1 life, 1 strength, 0 bleed.
Procurer may move 1 blood from the blood bank to a ready vampire you
control as a +2 stealth action.

non unique, 1 less life, no clan restriction, only moves blood to a
vampire you control, ghoul, more stealth.

very similar and possibly slightly better, but not strictly better as
Leo can for example be used to help other players.

also, charisma or Regina make it possible to get Loe for free!

Messages.Author: Matthew T. Morgan
Messages.Body:



Nope. Your only solution is to have Leonardo rush any Procurers he sees.
Leonardo has 2 life while the Procurers only have 1, so he'll be able to
kill them and then corner the market.

You could also ghoul Leonardo so he can rush with Thrown Gates. Procurers
can't be ghouled.

But seriously, you can get Leonardo for free with Sunset Strip, Charisma
or Regina and in any case he never costs blood. Procurers cost 2 blood,
so you'll need them to procure three times before you make any profit.
Even then, it's just as good as a hunt (1 action, net gain 1 blood).

Finally, Leonardo can give blood to any vampire. Procurers can only feed
your own.

I think there's still room for Leonardo.

Matt Morgan
